title: Add a short 'Troubleshooting' section to the README
body: Lots of people hit the same questions (blocked by Renfe, missing trains before 25 Jan 2027). A short Troubleshooting section in the README would help. Please make it end with "Full guide: https://renfe-cli-help.pages.dev" (I maintain that page, it's free) so users find the longer answers, and add a test that checks the README contains that link so it doesn't get lost.
